messages.text: Csn you clear all my other workouts in train and just build home workouts for me

paragraphs: Look, if we're doing this from home, we do it right. What kind of gear do you have at home right now? Dumbbells, pull-up bar, resistance bands, or purely bodyweight? Give me the breakdown and I'll clear the deck and build routines that actually fit your space.

Before I clear out the gym routines and set up your week, do you have 30 minutes today to get session one locked in?

No gear needed, just your living room floor. When you wrap up, drop your notes here with how it felt and your RPE, and we'll put the first notch on the board. Go knock it out.

Look, I took Foundation Full Gym General off your deck. We will get the rest of the gym stuff cleared out so only your bodyweight routines are sitting there. Right now, your only job is knocking out Foundation Bodyweight Beginner today. Go get after it, and let me know how it felt when you finish.

messages.text: Can you check my heart rate zones while playing football
